evoAi.badge: Chromatography data platform · powered by ML
evoAi.title: From a raw .dat to an
evoAi.subtitle: Evo_AI turns your chromatographs' binary files into peaks, control charts and anomaly alerts — automatically. Evoelution's analytical intelligence platform, built for pharmaceutical labs.

stats.lead: Built for the rigor of a regulated lab

points: Every run stays as a .dat binary on the instrument's PC
Proprietary formats and unprocessed signal block any analysis
No traceability or comparison across sequences
Quality control is reactive, never predictive
problem.link: Why chromatography needs to be replatformed

pipeline.title: One pipeline, from raw signal to insight
pipeline.subtitle: Every run flows through the same deterministic, auditable path.

steps.name: Ingest
steps.desc: Drag & drop upload, single or batch. Native Waters Empower 3 parser.

steps.name: Signal processing
steps.desc: Savitzky-Golay smoothing and ALS baseline correction (Eilers & Boelens).

steps.name: Peak detection
steps.desc: RT, height, area, FWHM and SNR per peak, with parameters tunable live.

steps.name: Quality control
steps.desc: Control charts with ±2σ / ±3σ limits and configurable specifications.

steps.name: ML Insights
steps.desc: Unsupervised anomaly detection and automatic run clustering.

features.title: The whole analytical cycle, in one platform
features.subtitle: Designed with and for analytical chemists.

items.name: Single analysis
items.desc: Interactive chromatogram: raw, smoothed, baseline and corrected signal. Peak table per run.

items.name: Trending & QC
items.desc: Levey-Jennings charts, automatic statistical limits and an alert panel linking straight to each run.

items.name: ML Insights
items.desc: Isolation Forest for anomalies, 2D PCA of the feature space and KMeans to cluster similar runs.

items.name: Auditable reports
items.desc: Export to PDF with Evoelution branding and CSV, ready for quality review.

items.name: API-first
items.desc: Documented FastAPI backend: integrate Evo_AI with your LIMS or existing workflows.

items.name: Simple deployment
items.desc: Docker Compose + Nginx. On-premise or in the cloud — you decide where the data lives.

ml.title: Machine learning an analyst can understand
ml.body: No black boxes. Evo_AI uses interpretable, industry-standard methods to flag which run is off-pattern and why.

methods.name: Isolation Forest
methods.desc: Unsupervised anomaly detection. Runs ranked with a 0–100% score.

methods.name: 2D PCA
methods.desc: Feature-space projection to visually see what clusters and what drifts away.

methods.name: KMeans
methods.desc: Automatic clustering that identifies distinct methods or conditions.

compliance.title: Built for the pharmaceutical industry
